paper: ContestTrade: A Multi-Agent Trading System Based on Internal Contest Mechanism
headline_strategy: Daily China A-share multi-agent pipeline in which data agents generate factor context, a token-budgeted diversity-aware Data Contest allocates information, research agents produce signals, a Research Contest scores and positive-Sharpe-weights them, and the resulting portfolio trades under T+1 and price-limit constraints
paper_portability_to_common_task: not defensibly executable because the public entrypoint bypasses both contests and portfolio construction, while isolated contest code is incomplete and lacks experiment inputs/outputs
missing_or_conflicting_headline_objects: an active entrypoint connecting Data Contest, Research Contest and portfolio construction
the paper's facility-location/lazy-greedy token allocator and embedding-cosine diversity implementation
rolling Data Contest training data, dates, split, seed and model provenance
the two Research Contest models and its called predict_signal_scores method
paper input snapshot, point-in-time universe, model/API snapshots, prompts/responses and seeds
portfolio/backtester, baselines, ablation runner, metrics, holdings, returns and result logs
paper-consistent signed ZI reward and five-day research horizon

rejected_substitutes.reason: It consumes missing research signals/scores and is not reachable from the entrypoint or an executed paper portfolio.

rejected_substitutes.route: Repair missing methods/models with researcher implementations
rejected_substitutes.reason: The input panel, training protocol, contest scoring, factor allocation, portfolio, and result evaluator would all remain invented.

result_policy: No contest-bypassing CLI output, unproven Data model, isolated normalizer, fork portfolio, author raster, or researcher repair is entered as a ContestTrade return. The positive paper claims remain unresolved rather than classified as false or as JKP underperformance.
